svg.title: MediaLog: a media diary you share, as a shaded block NFO
svg.desc: A 1990s shaded block NFO screen, drawn in block and shade characters. MediaLog in heavy condensed block letters beside the app's open-book mark (a play triangle on the left page, a pen on the right), each stroke with a band of dark shade on its shadow side in the colour of a kind of media; the g's tail dissolves into dots, with debris and broken bands of light shade behind. Caption: everything you've watched, on one timeline, the verb cycling through watched, read, played and listened to, each in a kind's colour. Kinds: Movies, TV shows, Anime, Books, Comics, Manga, Games, Podcasts, Music, Videos. A timeline grows from the book's spine and fades as it goes back: 2025-2029, 2026: 21 Mar, Quorum, TV show, S2 E1-10, loved, note Watched the vote twice; Feb, Middlemarch, Book, George Eliot, audiobook, liked. 2015-2019, 2016: 12 Nov, Pigeon Census, Game, Breadcrumb Interactive, loved. Sometime in 2015-2019: Moderately Large Shark, Movie, Lorna Fathom, Big enough; Songs to Defrost a Freezer To, Music, The Damp Tuesdays, liked. Key: solid, to the day; dark shade, to the month; medium shade, sometime in; light shade, not logged yet. Footer: a log, five years at a time. Signed nib!5yd.
